# Lingua Class

> Self-hosted web platform for a small English-language class: accounts, groups, lessons and LiveKit video lessons today; recordings, transcripts, vocabulary and spaced repetition planned.

Lingua Class is an early MVP for 5 teachers and 50 students on one VPS. The core is a Docker Compose monolith: a Go REST API (`backend/`), a Next.js web app (`web/`) and Postgres, behind Caddy. Heavy subsystems are managed or OSS services, most of them still planned: LiveKit Cloud for video, AWS S3 for files and recordings, AssemblyAI for speaker-labelled transcripts, LibreTranslate and an Excalidraw whiteboard. Work proceeds in stages 0 to 5, tracked in a single task index. Documentation is in Russian.
